verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a dedicated extraction capability that crawls relevant pages and returns an object matching a user-supplied JSON Schema, with grounding, coverage and freshness controls. It also offers CSS-selected field scraping and JSON responses from the CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of JSON extraction quality, and deeper documentation of schema limits and output edge cases.

support.subject: As a developer, I can receive scraped content as structured JSON

citations.quote: Crawl relevant pages and return an object that matches your JSON Schema, with controls for grounding, coverage, and freshness.
Start from a URL, read relevant pages, and return data shaped by your JSON Schema.
extract JSON for AI agents and applications
